summary: Mayfair Gold filed a Form 6-K (Canadian equivalent of a US Form 8-K) attaching a Material Change Report disclosing a strategic financing package for its 100%-owned Fenn-Gib Gold Project. Macquarie subscribed for C$10 million of common shares at C$4.26, a 10% premium to the 5-day VWAP, and signed a non-binding engagement letter for a proposed C$300 million project finance facility, totaling up to C$310 million. The facility carries CORRA plus 4.75%, stepping to plus 4.25% post-completion, secured by first-ranking project security, with a 50,000 oz/year gold offtake (max 300,000 oz) at reference price less US$50/oz. Watch lender syndication of at least 30% and definitive facility documentation risk.
